terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The terms that govern your use of Trash and its connected services.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By creating an account or using Trash, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, do not use the service.

sections.title: 2. Your account
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials secure and for all activity that occurs under your account. You must provide accurate information when signing up and notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

sections.title: 3. Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree not to misuse the service, including attempting to gain unauthorized access, interfering with the operation of the service, or using it for any unlawful purpose.

sections.title: 4. Connected applications
sections.body: You may connect third-party applications to your account. These applications may request access to your data. It is your responsibility to review the permissions an application requests before authorizing it.

sections.title: 5. Termination
sections.body: You may stop using the service at any time. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or pose a risk to the service or its users.

sections.title: 6. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

sections.title: 7. Disclaimer
sections.body: The service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis, without warranties of any kind, express or implied, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Trash collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

sections.title: 1. Information we collect
sections.body: We collect the information you provide when creating an account, such as your email address, username, and password. We also collect profile details you choose to add, such as your name, gender, and profile picture.

sections.title: 2. How we use your information
sections.body: We use your information to provide and secure the service, authenticate your sessions, and share account and profile details with applications you explicitly authorize.

sections.title: 3. Sharing with connected applications
sections.body: Your information is only shared with third-party applications after you authorize them and approve the requested permissions. You can review and revoke these connections at any time from your settings.

sections.title: 4. Data retention
sections.body: We retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the service. You can delete your account, which removes your data from the service.

sections.title: 5. Security
sections.body: We take reasonable measures to protect your information against unauthorized access or disclosure. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.body: You can access, update, or delete your account information at any time from your settings. You may also revoke permissions previously granted to connected applications.

sections.title: 7. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We will indicate the date of the latest revision at the top of this page. Continued use of the service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.title: 8. Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy or how your data is handled, contact us at support@trash.app.
